name: Takara Sushi (Logan) Salmon, Tuna & Yellowtail Nigiri + Miso Soup
whyItWorks: Pure raw salmon, tuna, albacore, or tamago (sweet egg) over seasoned white sushi rice with a warm bowl of probiotic miso broth—nearly zero fiber and zero dairy.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Salmon (Sake), Tuna (Maguro), Yellowtail (Hamachi), or Tamago Nigiri with a cup of Miso Soup and gluten-free tamari/soy sauce.
watchOuts: Skip wasabi paste and raw jalapeño toppings
